title: Recast the Past: Stable Long Video Generation with Full Context Memory
title_zh: 重铸过去：基于全上下文记忆的稳定长视频生成

paragraphs.en: 总结：本文提出ReCam方法，通过记忆令牌与双指针去噪实现稳定的长时间视频生成，在VBench-Long上取得最高分80.1。 Long-horizon video generation requires retaining an ever-expanding history, but conditioning on its growing token sequence is costly. Existing methods restrict or compress historical context, potentially losing information needed for future generation. This work proposes ReCam, which groups local spatiotemporal blocks of historical latents into vectors and projects them directly into the high-dimensional hidden space of a Diffusion Transformer. The model learns to use the resulting memory tokens through native self-attention, reducing token count while retaining block-level access to the full history. To mitigate temporal drift during autoregressive rollout, we further introduce dual-pointer denoising with separate noise schedules for recent context and target frames. Among the evaluated methods, ReCam achieves the highest VBench-Long overall score of 80.1 and competitive static-scene revisitation performance on R2M-Bench. It also leads on all four consistency metrics for off-screen subject reappearance, including clothing consistency of 4.09 versus 3.03 for the best baseline.
paragraphs.zh: 总结：本文提出ReCam方法，通过记忆令牌与双指针去噪实现稳定的长时间视频生成，在VBench-Long上取得最高分80.1。长时间视频生成需要保留不断扩展的历史信息，但以其不断增长的令牌序列作为条件代价高昂。 现有方法限制或压缩历史上下文，可能丢失未来生成所需的信息。 本工作提出ReCam，将历史潜变量的局部时空块分组为向量，并直接投影到扩散Transformer的高维隐空间中。 模型通过原生自注意力学会使用由此得到的记忆令牌，在减少令牌数量的同时保留对全部历史的块级访问。 为缓解自回归生成过程中的时间漂移，我们进一步引入双指针去噪，对近期上下文与目标帧采用各自的噪声调度。 在所评估的方法中，ReCam在VBench-Long上取得最高的总体得分80.1，并在R2M-Bench上取得有竞争力的静态场景重访性能。 在画外主体重现的全部四个一致性指标上它也均居首位，包括服装一致性达4.09，而最佳基线为3.03。
